@graph.name: Rhinoplasty Surgery
@graph.description: Visit Derma Solutions for the Best Rhinoplasty surgery in Marathahalli - Whitefield. Safe & Affordable. Senior Plastic Surgeon. Book Your Appointment Today!
@graph.howPerformed: Your surgeon evaluates your nasal structure and creates a customized surgical plan. You'll receive detailed instructions on medications, diet and lifestyle, including avoiding smoking and alcohol for at least two weeks before surgery. The procedure is done under general or local anaesthesia and reshapes the nasal bone and cartilage to achieve your goals.

acceptedAnswer.text: The procedure is performed under anaesthesia, so there's no pain during surgery. Mild discomfort during recovery can be managed with medication.
Most patients recover within 2–3 weeks. The splint comes off after about a week, and swelling settles gradually over the following months.
Closed rhinoplasty leaves no visible external scars. Open rhinoplasty may leave a small scar that fades over time.

mainEntity.name: What care is needed after rhinoplasty?

acceptedAnswer.text: Keep your head elevated to reduce swelling, avoid strenuous activity for 2–3 weeks, and wait around 2 months before returning to gym workouts or sports.
